type_code_desc: Show a copy button next to inline code (`code`).
type_bold_desc: Show a copy button next to bold text (**text**, __text__).
type_bold_italic_desc: Show a copy button next to bold italic text (***text***, ___text___).
type_italic_desc: Show a copy button next to italic text (*text*, _text_).
type_underline_desc: Show a copy button next to underlined text (<u>text</u>).
type_strikethrough_desc: Show a copy button next to strikethrough text (~~text~~).
type_highlight_desc: Show a copy button next to highlighted text (==text==).
type_heading_desc: Show a copy button next to heading lines (# ~ ######).
type_tag_desc: Show a copy button next to tags (#tag); copied text includes the # prefix.
type_internal_link_desc: Show a copy button next to internal links. Both Wiki ([[note]]) and Markdown ([note](note.md)) formats are copied as-is.
type_external_link_desc: Show a copy button next to external links. Supports http(s)://, obsidian:// URIs, and <angle-bracket> URLs. Copied text is [name](url) when a name is present, or the bare link otherwise.
copy_button_icon_desc: Choose the icon for the copy button.
show_notification_desc: Show a notice when content is copied to clipboard.
reset_defaults_desc: Restore all settings to their factory defaults.
reset_confirm: Reset all settings to defaults? This cannot be undone.
copy_failed: Copy failed. Clipboard is unavailable in this context.
